card.name: Capital D starting a new word
card.fires_on: A capital D (or "-d" after "non") that begins a new term, right after a space, "non", or an opening parenthesis. The rest of the word is not yet written, as in DRI, Dilmun, DRESS and non-discriminatory.

modes.label: Capital D starting a name or acronym
modes.description: A capital D opens an acronym or proper name such as DRI, DRESS, Dardanelles or Datasets.

modes.label: Hyphen-d after non
modes.description: The "-d" after "non" begins a word like discriminatory, discrimination or diet.
